entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed.
Support.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. Just give me the return authorization number.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Alex Chen. a.chen@email.com. Order number is 772-B1-904.

Thank you, Alex. Pulling that up now... I see the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 31st. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
I don't have time for a survey. I just want to return it. Yes or no, can I return it?

I understand you're busy. I do need to ask to follow procedure. Looking at the dates, it shows the item was delivered 19 days ago. The VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return window due to hygiene protocols and account activation.
That's ridiculous. I tried to return this thing 10 days ago, on January 9th. Your entire website was down. I couldn't get a label, I couldn't get a chat agent, nothing.
You're saying you attempted the return on January 9th but encountered a website error?

Yes, a huge one. The whole returns portal was giving me a 404 error. The system was down completely. I took a screenshot because I knew this would happen. I couldn't print the label because your site wouldn't generate it.
Thank you for clarifying, Alex. Let me check our internal system alerts for that date... Please hold one moment.

Okay, thank you for waiting. I am seeing a critical incident report for January 9th. It looks like our return authorization system was down for several hours that afternoon due to a server update. You are absolutely right. I sincerely apologize for that.
So you'll take it back then?

Yes. Since you attempted the return within the 10-day window and were prevented by a VeloFit system fault, I can override the date lock. I've just approved the return exception. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email now. You should see it in the next two minutes.
Okay. Good. Full refund to the original payment method?
Correct. Once the item is scanned by the carrier, the full refund will be processed automatically. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's it. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thank you for your patience, and have a great day.
